text:
Samira: hi team — Samira here, starting as a product designer today. tiny blockers: Figma invite shows \"request access\" and I can't find the \"Roadmap Decisions\" vault in Notion. Also hunting for past interview screener templates and the canonical consent language. who should i ping for a quick 10-min setup? thanks! :wave:

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Samira :tada:  Invite attempted to samira@redwood.ai. Roadmap Decisions vault: Notion > Product > Roadmap Decisions (https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Roadmap-Decisions). Research templates: Notion > Product > Research > Templates. If the Figma invite is stuck run `/resend_invite figma samira@redwood.ai` or reply \"manual add\" and an admin will help. Join #design and #research-ops.

Samira: tried resend, still shows the request screen in Edge.

Lucas: hey Samira — welcome! DM'd your figma email and adding you manually to the \"Product Design\" team now. I can do a 10-min walkthrough at 2:15pm: cover where we keep component tokens, how we publish libraries, and the handoff checklist we expect in PRDs. Want access to Mobile + Web libraries?

Samira: Mobile + Web please, that'd be great. thanks Lucas.

Product Onboarding Bot: manual add completed  Samira added to Figma team \"Product Design\". If libraries still missing open Figma > Assets > Libraries > Refresh or try incognito.

Samira: can open it now, thanks! quick follow-up: where are accessibility notes and any a11y checklist for designers?

Fiona: hi Samira, i'm Fiona (Design Ops)  welcome! accessibility checklist is in Notion: Design Playbook > Accessibility (includes color contrast, keyboard navigation checks, and aria guidance). We also have a short PRD a11y section we ask designers to fill out: `a11y-considerations` (copy-paste the checklist into your PRD). I can share a one-pager in this thread.

ResearchOpsBot: recordings/transcripts live in S3 and Drive depending on study; links are on each study Notion page. Screener & consent templates: Notion > Research > Templates > Screeners & Consent. For S3 access: SSO -> AWS -> Request role `research-read`. For Drive access request GSuite `research-view`.

Samira: perfect — one process Q: if i want to run a quick guerrilla usability test next week (4–6 unmoderated users), do i file anything formal?

Fiona: small guerrilla tests: fill the one-page intake on the Research template and tag `guerrilla-test`. No formal IRB needed unless collecting PII or offering payment. If you're compensating participants, run it by Research Ops and include the consent language. I'll DM you the intake template.

Lucas: handoff checklist we expect in PRDs: problem statement, flows/prototype link, acceptance criteria & success metric, tokens used, accessibility notes, and test cases. We also ask for the study id if research was used.

Samira: awesome. last thing: where do PMs put the decision history — i sometimes see threads and sometimes Notion pages. want to make sure I link the right place in my PRD.

Lucas: decision history belongs in the Roadmap Decisions vault (link above) — each decision page should include rationale, alternatives considered, who signed off, and links to the PRD. PMs typically link the decision page from the Feature Brief. If you need someone to walk through recent decisions for your area I can book 20m.

Samira: yes please, a quick sync would help. Thanks everyone 60a

Product Onboarding Bot: checklist summary: Figma access  confirmed; Notion Roadmap Decisions link  shared; Research templates  link shared; Accessibility playbook  link shared; Calendar: Lucas onboarding walkthrough 2:15pm.

Samira: all green, closing thread  see you at 2:15!
